Dear Nils Christen,
thank you for contacting Siemens eMobility Technical Support.
Our Technical Support team will create an official case in our ticketing system shortly and will inform you accordingly through email, including the official  case number of the incident.

SiCharge D

170001716, 170001717 und 170001719

Bitte warten Sie auf die offizielle Ticket Antwort und antworten Sie nicht auf diese E-Mail. Diese Mailbox wird nicht überwacht.
Falls Sie eine Störmeldung  für eine Ladestation auf einem Siemens Betriebsgelände abgesetzt haben,  werden wir diese an den Verantwortlichen des Betriebsgeländes weiterleiten. Sie erhalten keine weiteren Rückmeldungen.

Seriennummer:

additional_info.subject: ID0422296-DC/Si-D/DE-[Multiple] Cable issue CRM:00642002259
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
Stawag
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / R4 170001716
Charger ID/Serial No.: Multiple
Problem Description:
Cable issue
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 05/01/2025, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
If the clamps are defective or the adhesive is not strong enough, we recommend ordering a spare part. Please confirm and verify before placing the order.
MLFB:
8EM5905-0AA00-7AA1 (Cable management system cable clamps, set of two)
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
